finding.headline: "Sick Older Child + Newborn at Risk"
finding.problem: "My son has catarrh and keeps kissing the baby. What if she gets it? I'm disinfecting everything and losing my mind."
finding.person: Mum whose toddler/school kid brings home germs; she's terrified of newborn falling ill; isolation impossible.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (germ-management & newborn protection) — seasonal/urgent". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
